sloka: ते च सर्वे महात्मानः साग्निहोत्राः समागताः ।सपुत्रदाराः काकुत्स्थमनुजग्मुर्महामतिम् ।। ७.१०९.१२ ॥
transliteration: te ca sarve mahātmānaḥ sāgnihotrāḥ samāgatāḥ ।saputradārāḥ kākutsthamanujagmurmahāmatim ।। 7.109.12 ॥

translations.english: All those great-souled individuals, having assembled with their sacred fires, sons, and wives, followed the great-minded Rama.
